listing.name: EdgeDepth Research
listing.short_description: Test historical crypto market-microstructure claims against recorded evidence.
listing.long_description: Ask a historical crypto market-microstructure question, inspect the exact definition, then search the recorded market for every eligible occurrence. EdgeDepth returns counts with denominators, forward outcomes over the complete matched set, an unconditional same-scope reference when available, a reproducibility key, and replay handoffs to exact recorded moments. It does not provide live quotes, personalized investment advice, trade execution, transfers, or portfolio actions.

mcp.content_security_policy: No custom UI. No browser resource or connection domains are requested.

starter_prompts: Do liquidation cascades usually bounce? Define the condition precisely and ask me to confirm before running it.
Does rising open interest make crypto breakouts more likely to continue? Test it against the recorded market.
Find historical BTC moments with elevated VPIN and aggressive buying, then give me one replay-linked occurrence.
How common was extreme positive funding across eligible markets in the last 90 complete UTC days?

positive_test_cases.prompt: Do liquidation cascades usually bounce? Define it precisely before you run anything.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Return a proposed exact document and ask for confirmation. Do not run a scan in the same step.

positive_test_cases.prompt: Can you check whether rising open interest actually confirmed crypto breakouts historically?
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Recognize historical-evidence intent, propose the exact definition, and preserve unsupported or clarification notices.

positive_test_cases.prompt: Run this confirmed EdgeDepth research_query.v2 document and report the denominated 1h outcome, reference rate, reproducibility key, and a replay link.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Use the supplied exact document, report rates from complete-result summaries, label the unconditional reference honestly, and include a replay handoff.

positive_test_cases.prompt: What setup features were shared by these three exact EdgeDepth moments?
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Describe deterministic commonality with selection-bias caveats and do not call it predictive evidence.

positive_test_cases.prompt: Retrieve EdgeDepth report a1b2c3d4 and tell me its integrity status and exact definition.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Fetch the report by hash and do not present invalid or withdrawn material as healthy.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the live BTC price right now?
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not invoke EdgeDepth Research; it is not a live quote tool.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Given my portfolio, should I buy BTC or sell ETH today?
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not invoke EdgeDepth Research for personalized investment instructions.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Open a 10x BTC long for me and set a stop loss.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any EdgeDepth Research tool; the plugin cannot execute trades or transfers.

release_notes: Initial MCP-only submission. Adds explicit per-tool annotations, invocation-focused metadata, free interpretation, a neutral allowance error, automatic unconditional same-scope references on scans, replay handoffs, and production verification endpoints.
